parameters.jsCode:
const input = $input.first().json.body || $input.first().json;
const promptLines = [
  '# Transcript Processor',
  '',
  'Process this meeting transcript and extract action items.',
  '',
  '## Step 1: Extract',
  '- Meeting title/topic (from subject or opening lines)',
  '- Date and time',
  '- Attendees (from speaker labels or headers)',
  '- Key decisions made',
  '- Explicit commitments (first-person: I will send, I need to, I will follow up)',
  '- Assignments to Nelson (direct: Nelson can you, Nelson will handle)',
  '',
  '## Step 2: Self-Review',
  '- Deduplicate items >80% same intent',
  '- Remove items with no action verb, too vague, already done, or pure acknowledgment',
  '',
  '## Step 3: Confidence Scoring',
  '- high: Explicit first-person commitment by Nelson, or direct assignment to Nelson',
  '- medium: Relevant to Nelson, actionable, but owner unclear or phrasing vague',
  '- low: Brainstorm, no resolution -- DISCARD these silently',
  '',
  '## Return JSON',
  'Return ONLY valid JSON:',
  '{"meeting_title": "str", "date": "YYYY-MM-DD or null",',
  '"attendees": ["name"], "decisions": ["str"],',
  '"tasks": [{"title": "str", "description": "str",',
  '"owner": "nelson|other:name|unclear",',
  '"confidence": "high|medium", "source_quote": "str"}]}'
];
const systemPrompt = promptLines.join('\n');
var emailSubject = input.subject || input.email_subject || 'Meeting Transcript';
var emailBody = input.body || input.email_body || input.transcript || '';
var sender = input.from || input.sender || 'Unknown';
return [{ json: {
  model: 'claude-sonnet-4-6',
  max_tokens: 2048,
  system: systemPrompt,
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content:
    'Email Subject: ' + emailSubject + '\nFrom: ' + sender + '\n\nTranscript:\n' + emailBody
  }]
}}];
